sloka: रामो ऽभिवाद्य प्रयत आसनान्यादिदेश ह ।तेषु काञ्चनचित्रेषु महत्सु च वरेषु च ।। ७.१.१४ ॥
transliteration: rāmo 'bhivādya prayata āsanānyādideśa ha ।teṣu kāñcanacitreṣu mahatsu ca vareṣu ca ।। 7.1.14 ॥

translations.english: Rama, having saluted them with a composed mind, indeed offered them seats that were great, excellent, and adorned with gold.
